content: Hey here can you create a directory and literally follow these trails [pasted transcript of a parallel PMCR-O redesign session locking a design for /pmcro-orchestrator:orchestrate run + /cognitive-trail:initialize] ... within P:\ root create pmcro-skills and run setup project setup and change cognitive-trail to pmcro-trail and initialize to that open the cycle and trail-frame sets the frame ... feel free to call it pmcro-trail-frames, pmcro-trail-engine, pmcro-trail-cycle, whatever you recommend or even pmcro-cognitive-trail or even trail-as-product ... do this incrementally, build the PMCRO flow generating frames etc correctly ... note cycles or folder with each agent logging their own frame etc ... we're not copying P:\source\pmcro-skills, everything is here ... note that because of the Trail-as-Product idea we have trail-cycles / template-driven declarative design — frames should conform to a schema, not be hand-typed, and no drive-letter paths in system-authored fields

goal: Stand up a clean, self-contained target repo root (git init, no history/content copied from any other checkout on this host) and scaffold pmcro-trail + pmcro-orchestrator with the locked command contract. Trail-as-Product: every frame line in this and future trails conforms to plugins/pmcro-trail/skills/initialize/assets/schema.trail-frame.asset.json rather than being hand-typed.
name_rationale: Matches sibling plugin naming (pmcro-orchestrator, pmcro-loop, pmcro-skill-creator); plain over flavor-text per this session's naming convention.

steps.action: git init, local colony git identity, no remote/history
plugins/pmcro-trail: plugin.json, skills/initialize (SKILL.md + command/run/reject triad + schema.trail-frame.asset.json + references + scripts/New-Trail.ps1, Class B default)
plugins/pmcro-orchestrator: plugin.json, agents/orchestrator.agent.md, skills/orchestrate (SKILL.md + command/run/reject triad), run.orchestrate wired to call pmcro-trail's New-Trail on the mint path
checker: shape matches this plan, contracts consistent, no stray content, no drive-letter paths in system-authored fields
reflect-and-seed: seal trail, propose next seed

success_criteria: every file in steps 1-5 exists with the locked contract content
git status shows a clean, all-new working tree
each phase (plan/make/check/reflect) logs its own frame to its own jsonl file in this folder, appended incrementally as work happens, each line conforming to schema.trail-frame.asset.json
no absolute drive-letter paths in any system-authored (non-verbatim-quote) field
out_of_scope: the other role plugins (planner/maker/checker/reflector as products)
touching the other, separate checkout on this host
